Public repositories for numerical methods and collective quantum dynamics. Each repository contains its own source, examples, and license information.

::: {.code-project}
[JULIA · OPEN QUANTUM SYSTEMS]{.eyebrow}

## PIDicke.jl

Permutation-invariant open-system calculations for two-level emitters in the Dicke basis, including population dynamics, quantum trajectories, coherences, and spin–cavity models.

[Repository ↗](https://github.com/Nico0oblr/PiDicke.jl){.text-link} [Examples ↗](https://github.com/Nico0oblr/PiDicke.jl/tree/main/examples){.paper-link}
:::

::: {.code-project}
[JULIA · NUMERICAL METHODS]{.eyebrow}

## KrylovSolverMCWF

A Krylov-subspace approach to Monte Carlo wavefunction simulations with QuantumOptics.jl, with an example notebook.

[Repository ↗](https://github.com/Nico0oblr/KrylovSolverMCWF){.text-link}
:::
